name: mica
description: Mica CMS — a small, schema-driven content backend for static Astro business websites.

scripts.//typecheck: The website is included: its collection types now come from files in the repository, so nothing has to be running.
scripts.//build:schema: Compiles mica.config.ts into the JSON artifact the CMS container is given.
scripts.//cms:backup: There is no backup script: the content is in Git, and the database holds only accounts and sessions.
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules packages/*/dist apps/*/dist

//dependencies: mica.config.ts is this project's content model and imports the DSL, the same way a customer project would.
